name: Baron of the Lesser Ones
prerequisites: Empathy 2; Intimidation or Persuasion 2; Gentrified Bearing, Hob Kin, or Interdisciplinary Specialty (Goblins).
purpose: Act as liaison, mediator, messenger, and when necessary defender between the Lost and Hedge natives.
privileges: Goblins treat the Baron as kin, trust him with gossip and exclusive deals, and favor him when assigning tasks that repay Goblin Debt.
duties: Mediate conflicts and negotiations between changelings and hobgoblins, deliver messages or packages, and defend whichever side is in the right rather than serving personal interests.
maskAndMien: Durable traveling clothes or diplomatic dress carry winding thorn motifs recording the Baron's dealings. The Baron's fae features resemble a chosen hobgoblin, adding one goblin feature per two ranks invested.
heraldry: A shield composed of interlocking stylized brambles.

token.name: Seal of Thorns
token.description: A pewter and carnelian signet ring whose sigil glows when active.
token.effect: In the mundane world, automatically locate the nearest Hedge gate. In the Hedge, spend 1 Glamour up to rating times per chapter to make the Storyteller roll twice and take the worse result for one Hedge chase roll. Add rating to rolls made to safely deliver a missive or package bearing the seal.
token.catch: Affix the seal to a missive or package the user does not want safely delivered and send it in good faith during the same scene.
token.drawback: Activation inflicts a temporary Hedge Addiction Condition until the Baron yields to it at a highly inconvenient or dangerous time.

blessings.name: Glamour Gain
blessings.description: When the noble regains Willpower through her Needle in direct pursuit of the title's role, she also regains 1 Glamour. She may spend it immediately or store it in the heraldry token, up to her Wyrd. Stored Glamour empties at the end of the story.

blessings.name: Inherited Expertise
blessings.description: Gain a new Specialty relevant to the title's duty. Rolls using it achieve exceptional success with three successes.

blessings.name: Predecessor's Thread
blessings.description: Once per chapter, accept Shaken to remember a predecessor's traumatic experience and gain that predecessor's Thread in addition to the character's own for the chapter.

blessings.name: Hobgoblin Allies
blessings.description: Gain Allies equal to Wyrd/2, rounded up, for one particular hobgoblin group. These Allies remember favors performed by previous Barons.

blessings.name: Inherited Hostile Oath
blessings.description: Gain a hostile oath toward one specific changeling, inherited from unresolved enmity caused by a predecessor. Definitively fulfilling it refills all spent Willpower.

touchstone: A mortal the Baron rescued from danger in the Hedge.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered while favoring hobgoblin interests over changeling interests add damage dice equal to ranks invested in this Merit.
beat: Resolve a conflict with goblins, peacefully or otherwise, in a way that personally inconveniences the Baron or the motley.
legends: A Baron became a Goblin Queen and built a Hedge fund of debts and favors.
A Bridge-Burner Baron waged war on Hedge denizens until a successor took the title and repaired the damage.
A Baron inherited an oath of vengeance against his own husband and sacrificed himself to fulfill it.

name: Dauphines of Wayward Children
prerequisites: Wyrd 3; the selected role requires two dots in its Attribute and Skill.
purpose: Gather, guide, and protect willing wayward mortal or Lost children until they find a home or reach adulthood.
privileges: The legion title commands freehold respect and resources. Each role has its own reputation and authority concerning its wards.
duties: Never take an unwilling ward; aid the other Dauphines in protecting their wards; fulfill the selected role's particular method of care.
maskAndMien: The Sophomore becomes youthful and fantastical, the Chaperone mysterious and comforting, and the Dowager stern and protective. Each bears the appearance associated with the role.
heraldry: A stylized lily: yellow for Sophomore, blue for Chaperone, or violet for Dowager.

token.name: Dauphine's Lily
token.description: A dead flower brooch in the Mask and a vibrant living lily in the mien, colored for the role.
token.effect: Name up to rating current wards to know their distance and direction for the scene, or locate the nearest unclaimed wayward child. Add rating to the role's applicable actions. Spend 1 Glamour to let a ward see through fae Masks for the scene, up to rating times per scene.
token.catch: Tell someone a treasured or haunting childhood secret they did not already know.
token.drawback: The user gains Wanton (Sophomore), Spooked (Chaperone), or Stoic (Dowager).

roles.name: Sophomore
roles.privilege: A celebrated trickster and maverick who wins young hearts with freedom and wonder.
roles.duties: Offer a carefree wondrous life and teach wards how to pursue what they want, obeying no commands but their hearts.
roles.tokenBonus: Add token rating to Hedgespinning rolls to amaze a ward or grant the ward's heart's desire.

roles.name: Chaperone
roles.privilege: A trusted, miraculous caretaker to whom others entrust their most precious dependents and secrets.
roles.duties: Provide for wards and teach lessons through strange tests, magical puzzles, scavenger hunts, and other indirect wonders.
roles.tokenBonus: Add token rating to Contract rolls that lead a ward through riddles and adventures to learn something new.

roles.name: Dowager
roles.privilege: A formidable protector whose wards receive shelter, resources, and escape routes from other Lost.
roles.duties: Discipline, guard, train, and prepare wards to survive; punish both wards who imperil others and those responsible for a ward's harm.
roles.tokenBonus: Add token rating to mundane rolls to protect or avenge a ward.

blessings.name: Predecessor's Thread
blessings.description: Once per chapter, accept Shaken to remember a predecessor's traumatic experience and gain that predecessor's Thread in addition to the character's own for the chapter.

blessings.name: Inherited Gift Token
blessings.description: Gain a separate inherited token with rating equal to Wyrd/2, rounded up. Design it with the normal token rules.

blessings.name: Warded Dreams
blessings.description: Non-changeling wards gain Lucid Dreamer and treat their Bastions as Fortitude 1. Successful mundane actions in a ward's Bastion gain one additional success usable only for dreamweaving shifts.

touchstone: One of the Dauphine's mortal wards. This Touchstone is Conditional.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered because a ward is lost for any reason add damage dice equal to ranks invested in this Merit.
beat: Abandon an important responsibility or suffer harm to the Dauphine or motley while chasing and collecting a new ward.
legends: A Sophomore and her wards traded their memories to remain children forever.
A Chaperone staged an egg hunt to secretly choose the heir to the Blue Lily.
A Dowager's mortal murderer kept the Violet Lily, awaiting the changeling who would seek it.

name: Master of Keys
prerequisites: Investigation 2, Empathy 2, and any Merit concerned with uncovering secrets, such as Diviner, Hedge Sense, or Trained Observer.
purpose: Discover meaningful secrets, hidden places, locked wonders, and metaphorical keys, then preserve them for the title.
privileges: Supernatural beings often grant access to secret sanctuaries and resources because the Master could otherwise find a way inside; discovered secrets and treasures are the title's central reward.
duties: Continuously pursue meaningful secrets and keep them from indiscriminate revelation or use against the Master and allies.
maskAndMien: Keys constantly spill from the Master's clothes in the Mask. In the mien, fingers, toes, and even the tongue become keys, never made of iron.
heraldry: The Last Key: an ominous silver key with an elegant design of creeping vines and peering eyes.

token.name: Last Key
token.description: The key that represents the Master's unknowable doom; its Mask and mien are identical.
token.effect: Passively tarnishes near someone who secretly means the Master deadly harm, once per moonlit night. If the Master knowingly permits that enemy to act, regain 1 Willpower. When activated, grant rote quality on rating rolls per story to unlock keyed physical, Social, or mystical barriers.
token.catch: Dramatically fail one of the user's own actions during the scene, before or after activation; a later dramatic failure refunds the Glamour spent.
token.drawback: The user suffers a temporary Obsession concerning whatever is found after unlocking something.

blessings.name: Hidden Library
blessings.description: Gain Safe Place 1 containing Library 2 for a chosen Mental Skill. The Last Key may make any mundane door lead there through portaling.

blessings.name: Rekey Hedgeway
blessings.description: Spend 1 additional Glamour when portaling through a closeable Hedge portal to assign the dormant Hedgeway a new Key that mortals could research, possess, or perform.

touchstone: A mortal whose secret the Master knows and keeps. This Touchstone is Conditional.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered when choosing to keep a secret whose revelation would aid the Master or an ally add damage dice equal to ranks invested in this Merit.
beat: After investing at least one rank, maintain an additional Aspiration tied to pursuing a dangerous secret; replace it at chapter end after fulfillment.
legends: A Master opened the Underworld and traded his life to save the freehold from a ghost army.
A Master found a Huntsman's heart in dreams and bound it to his Wyrd as a token.
A Master traded escaped changelings' secrets to the Smiling Lady and passed the dangerous bargain onward.

name: Thorn Dancer
prerequisites: Socialize 2, Athletics 3, Expression 2, and at least one Specialty related to movement, such as Wrestling, Parkour, or Ballet.
purpose: Travel the Hedge with grace and panache, guide others through its dangers, and preserve the stories found along the way.
privileges: Move through the Hedge without fearing many dangers that threaten ordinary changelings. Courts, freeholds, Groves, Hollows, hobgoblins, and even some True Fae react strongly to the Dancer's fame and freedom.
duties: Transport others through the Hedge and make a memorable performance of the journey; the title does not require that every charge be brought to safety.
maskAndMien: The Thorn Dancer appears immaculate and sharply in focus. Her fae features become deliberate and vivid, petrichor and fresh earth follow her, and gentle breezes make her clothing billow.
heraldry: A winged sandal encircled, but not pierced, by a rose vine.

token.name: Talaria
token.description: Old casual sandals in the Mask; blooming-vine gladiator boots with fluttering wings in the mien.
token.effect: Passively ignore environmental levels 1-3 and falling damage from less than 30 yards or meters. When activated in the Hedge, ignore Conditions inflicted by the Thorns; spend 1 Willpower per other person to extend this protection.
token.catch: Accept Reckless instead of spending Glamour to activate the Talaria.
token.drawback: Gain Notoriety whenever the Talaria are activated in the Hedge.

blessings.name: Hedge Native
blessings.description: Gain Arcadian Metabolism and Hob Kin automatically.

blessings.name: Hedge Clarity Guard
blessings.description: Clarity attacks suffered in the Hedge are reduced by two dice instead of one.

touchstone: The first song that made the Thorn Dancer cry after taking up the title.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered outside the Hedge add damage dice equal to ranks invested in this Merit.
beat: Willingly help someone cross an enemy-infested region of the Hedge without payment or oath.
legends: A Dancer snubbed a Spring King to help his Avowed wife, who had been trapped in hobgoblin form.
A murdered Dancer's voice haunted her motley through dreams until they avenged her.
A Huntsman fell in love with a Dancer during their chase and may still seek the current title holder.

name: Sibylline Fisher
purpose: Collect secrets from the BriarNet, dreams, and Thorns, then connect hidden truths with the people who seek them.
privileges: Secrets reveal themselves in fragments, petitioners seek the Fisher as an oracle or information broker, and even Gentry and Huntsmen may pay generously for true answers.
duties: Seek meaningful secrets, interpret them in context, and deliver them to those who need to hear them while accepting the questions and consequences that follow.
maskAndMien: A closed-eye mark appears as a scar, tattoo, or device engraving in the Mask. The mien gains an uncovered pitch-black oracle's eye whose placement shifts when concealed.
heraldry: A stylized closed eye, surrounded by the individual Fisher title's personal ciphers and symbols.

token.name: Pythia Program
token.description: A Glamour-coded program accessible on any internet-capable device, appearing as an unpolished site or app in the Mask.
token.effect: Activation organizes accumulated secrets into past, present, or future insight. Past grants Investigation Clues or Social leverage equal to rating. Present functions as Cracking Software with rating as its bonus, including in the BriarNet. Future extracts a promise from the Wyrd after the Fisher accepts damage, a detrimental Condition, or another price set by the Storyteller.
token.catch: The Fisher was formally petitioned, received no compensation, and expects none.
token.drawback: Gain Notoriety because Hedge denizens recognize that the Fisher knows too much.

blessings.name: Secrets Cannot Hide
blessings.description: Automatically know the precise wording of fates and destinies connected to those you meet. Investigation rolls to uncover a secret gain 8-again.

blessings.name: Oracular Gravity
blessings.description: While acting according to the oracle's duties, roll Presence + Expression, penalized by group size (-1 small group, -2 small crowd, -3 large crowd), to gain Connected (Persistent).

touchstone: A mortal supplicant who has repeatedly sought the Fisher's advice since she took the title. This Touchstone is Conditional.
curse: Suffer a Clarity attack whenever one of the Fisher's own secrets is revealed, even voluntarily.
beat: Connect a secret to the individual trying to keep it hidden.
legends: A rumored seventh Fisher searched other realms through a BriarNet backdoor and never returned.
The Fishers blackmailed a Keeper into returning one of their own, but none remembers the secret they used.
A Fisher erased his memories after finding an unbearable secret, only for his successor to repeat his path.

name: Spiderborn Rider
purpose: Roam the trods freely, oppose slavery and coercion, and keep the Hedge safe for changelings who refuse masters.
privileges: Riders are recognized by their colors as uncompromising liberators who can be relied on when chains, privateers, or tyrannical rulers threaten the Lost.
duties: Never surrender a changeling to privateers, help those who ask to escape bondage, accept no master, and preserve personal choice even when doing so disrupts allies' plans.
maskAndMien: The Rider always wears a vest whose patches tell his history. In the mien, the blue broken web and lightning become a tattoo, bodily pattern, or mark on cloth-like skin.
heraldry: A blue web ripped apart by a lightning bolt.

token.name: The Colors
token.description: Cut-off vest patches or insignia that identify a Spiderborn Rider.
token.effect: Spend 1 Glamour after a glance and handshake, up to rating times per chapter, to learn all oaths, pledges, and formal bonds a person possesses. Add rating to Intimidation rolls against servants of the Fae.
token.catch: For the rest of the chapter, do not spend Willpower to improve your own dice pools unless doing so explicitly benefits others.
token.drawback: Gain Shaken as fear of the durance and renewed captivity overwhelms the Rider.

blessings.name: Indomitable Rider
blessings.description: Gain Indomitable. If already possessed, instead gain two additional dice to resist supernatural mental influence.

blessings.name: Where Needed Most
blessings.description: When finding a path through the Hedge, spend 1 Glamour to be led not where you want to go, but where you are needed most.

touchstone: A mortal known before taking the title who reminds the Rider how much she has changed and why the Hedge is now her true home.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered after refusing to assist another changeling in the Hedge or others in comparable need add damage dice equal to ranks invested in this Merit.
beat: Free someone from a dangerous bargain or make the Hedge safer for all Lost.
legends: A nameless Rider fought the Highway Kings and may now secretly rule and sabotage them.
A Rider died fighting his own motley to stop them from freeing hobgoblins devoted to a Goblin Queen.
A paranoid Rider exiled herself into the Hedge to destroy her own mind rather than risk serving her Keeper.

name: Adjudicator of the Wheel
purpose: Right wrongs and impose justice even when the law fails.
tokenEffect: Gain 9-again on mission-related Investigation actions. Its rating can twist an unfolding story within the Judge's presence, and once per chapter it can grant rote action to a roll that indirectly furthers justice.
tokenCatch: Place a thread from the current target's clothing on the Wheel and cut it in half.
tokenDrawback: Gain Obsession concerning the investigation or punishment.

specialBlessings.name: Judge's Kenning
specialBlessings.description: When using Kenning, spend 1 Glamour to see the most likely future of one observed subject up to Wyrd/2 days ahead.

specialBlessings.name: Vicarious Hostile Oath
specialBlessings.description: Swear a hostile oath on another person's behalf, making its effects bind the Adjudicator and a third party.

touchstone: A mortal whom the Adjudicator previously failed to protect from injustice.
curse: Clarity attacks caused by knowingly allowing injustice add dice equal to invested ranks.
beat: Right an injustice at significant personal or motley cost.
privileges: The title grants the authority, reputation, and supernatural advantages described by Judge's Zeal.
duties: The titleholder must pursue right wrongs and impose justice even when the law fails. and uphold the title's traditions.
maskAndMien: The title reshapes the changeling's mien and marks her with its heraldic imagery.
heraldry: The heraldry associated with Adjudicator of the Wheel.

name: The Blackbird Bishop
purpose: Ease anguish, hear confession, and guide the suffering toward restitution.

tokenCatch: Fill it with natural water mixed with the Bishop's tears.
tokenDrawback: Gain Confused, Guilty, or Withdrawn, chosen by the Storyteller.

specialBlessings.name: Blackbird Flock
specialBlessings.description: Gain a Wyrd/2-dot Retainer, rounded up, formed by dark-feathered birds that recognize mental Conditions.

specialBlessings.name: Sealed Amends
specialBlessings.description: Freely seal a sincere confession and plan for amends; fulfillment restores Clarity damage or Integrity lost to the wrongdoing and restores 1 Willpower to the Bishop.

beat: Enter physical danger to preserve another person's Clarity or Integrity.

name: Diviners of Worms
purpose: Read omens and warn others of dangers written into Fate.
tokenEffect: Use Diviner without entering a dream: each question takes two turns, ask up to the Instrument's rating questions plus one follow-up each without consuming dream-based questions. Once per chapter, perform an extended Intelligence + Occult Research action (ten minutes per roll), adding rating as Library dots, to gain Informed; the roll that spends Informed gains the same bonus. Once per chapter, spend 1 Glamour before persuading others about a prophecy to exceptionally succeed on three successes.
tokenCatch: Take 1 lethal damage from a helpless victim and spread the blood on the Instrument; self-harm cannot satisfy this Catch.
tokenDrawback: Gain Distracted as everything appears portentous; it does not penalize use of the token or rolls benefiting from it.

specialBlessings.name: Omens of Fate
specialBlessings.description: Use Common Sense through observed omens with a bonus equal to Wyrd/2, rounded up.

specialBlessings.name: Prophetic Danger Sense
specialBlessings.description: Gain enhanced Danger Sense against every immediate threat, including environmental dangers; double its bonus if the Instrument was activated this scene.

touchstone: A mortal once protected by the Diviner's prophecies.
curse: Clarity attacks suffered when someone rejects the Diviner's prophecy add dice equal to invested ranks.

heraldry: The heraldry associated with Diviners of Worms.

name: Duchess of Truth and Loss
prerequisites: Wits 3, Investigation 2, and must have killed a fetch.
purpose: Hunt concealed people and reveal the truth of stolen lives.
tokenEffect: Feed its mouth a subject's hair or blood to identify them infallibly as fetch, human, or changeling, bypassing concealment without a Clash; it remains silent for other beings. When worn, impose the token's rating as a penalty on any mundane or mystical attempt by a fetch to locate the user. A fetch can never use it.
tokenCatch: Stab yourself with its pin and leave it in your flesh for the scene, suffering -1 to actions.
tokenDrawback: You cannot knowingly lie during the next scene; serious trouble caused by this grants a Beat.

specialBlessings.name: Relentless Quarry
specialBlessings.description: Add Wyrd/2, rounded up, to Investigation, Survival, and Perception rolls to locate someone actively hiding from the Duchess.

specialBlessings.name: Preserve Fetch
specialBlessings.description: Touch a dead or dying fetch and spend 1 Glamour to prevent its dissolution for one lunar month; presenting it to its changeling heals one minor Clarity damage and refreshes Willpower.

touchstone: An object instrumental in the death of the first fetch the Duchess killed.
curse: Clarity attacks caused by others defending the Duchess's quarry add dice equal to invested ranks.
beat: Pursue a hidden truth despite grave personal consequences.
privileges: The title grants the authority, reputation, and supernatural advantages described by Hunting Truth and Hiding Loss.
duties: The titleholder must pursue hunt concealed people and reveal the truth of stolen lives. and uphold the title's traditions.
maskAndMien: The title reshapes the changeling's mien and marks her with its heraldic imagery.
heraldry: The heraldry associated with Duchess of Truth and Loss.
